description: Find what is on in a named destination: events from today onwards. A recurring event's dates are its series span, so read its recurrence. Offer booking_url when present; cite canonical_url, the destination's page.

area.description: Area name or slug; destination_overview lists them.

category.description: Category name or slug; destination_overview lists them.

cursor.description: Number of items to skip; pass `next_cursor` from the previous page.

destination.description: Destination name or slug, e.g. 'Los Cabos'; list_cities names them.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

query.description: Words matched in any order against event names and descriptions.

to_date.description: ISO date; omit to_date for everything upcoming (recommended for "coming up").

name: destination_events

outputSchema.description: The Yenta response envelope: a status, the answer in `item` or `items`, and the approved content revision it was read from.

title: Search a destination's events by name
